messages:
noor (evals): Flagging an oddity after onboarding mariner-v2-q4 (int4-ish). Mixed Chinese+Hebrew subtitle tests show chrF drop ~0.12 and punctuation shuffling around bidi boundaries. Not present on fp16. :warning:

anya (eng-ml): thats worrying. is this limited to decoding or tokenization stage?

noor (evals): initial diffs point at token-level shifts. small example: src/ref/output below.
```
src: "第12章 — כותרת 12: תיאור פרק"
ref: "第12章 — כותרת 12: תיאור הפרק"
mariner-v2-fp16: "第12章 — כותרת 12: תיאור הפרק"
mariner-v2-q4: "第 12 章 — \u200fכותרת 12: תיאור פרק"
```
noor (evals): Note the extra space and the LTR mark (\u200f) inserted near the CJK/Hebrew boundary in q4 output.

tim (quant): Hmm. q4 export applied weight quant + tokenizer minified binary + digit normaliser (normalize_digits=true) + small post-tokenizer unicode clean. I wonder if the minifier dropped a zero-width joiner handling rule.

ravi (serving): On canary we also saw `decoder: kv_index_mismatch seq=9 expected_off=36 got_off=40` twice in logs around the same request id. Could be token id->kv offset mismatch during incremental decode.

jena (infra): ops-bot captured the export job: `EXPORT mariner-v2 -> q4 (minify_tok=true, normalize_digits=true, fold_ln=false) COMPLETE` no failures. Serving logs (canary) at 3112239955 show the kv warnings ravi mentioned.

noor (evals): token dumps for that example from both variants: 
```
# mariner-v2-fp16 tokens: ['第','12','章',' ','—',' ', 'כותרת',' ','12',':',' ','תיאור','_','הפרק']
# mariner-v2-q4 tokens: ['第',' ','12',' ','章',' ','—',' ', '\u200fכותרת',' ','12',':',' ','תיאור',' ','פרק']
```
noor (evals): you can see token boundary shifts: a spacer was injected inside the CJK cluster and the hebrew token got a bidi mark prefixed.

tim (quant): That spacer looks like an ascii-space insertion during normalization that treats contiguous digits as separate tokens when minified tokenizer uses a fallback regex. The bidi mark could come from a normalization pass that tries to anchor RTL spans when it detects non-ascii punctuation. Strange that fp16 didn't do it. Maybe our minified tokenizer binary has a different normalization table.

olga (solutions): Customer impact: partner Y uses hard-timed captions; an extra space in CJK chapter numbering breaks alignment and could break their subtitle parser. We should hold q4 in prod until resolved.

ravi (serving): Agreed. I've paused q4 routing in ap-northeast-1 and eu-west-1. Can add a per-model flag to prefer fp16 until a fix.

tim (quant): Immediate debugging plan: 1) run tokenization binary diffs (fp16 vs q4) `bin/tok_diff --left=mariner-v2-fp16 --right=mariner-v2-q4 --input testcases/mixed_cjk_he.srt` 2) disable normalize_digits to see if LRMARK still appears 3) reproduce kv_index_mismatch with a debug build of runtime that logs token_id->kv_offset map.

noor (evals): I'll run a targeted eval subset that filters for patterns: (CJK chapter headers) + (Hebrew/Arabic inline) + (digits/punct) and report chrF/BLEU deltas.

jena (infra): ops-bot note: rollback executed for mariner-v2-q4 in ap-northeast-1 at 3112239970, routing -> fp16.

anya (eng-ml): can tim attach the tokenizer binary checksums? We should ensure the tokenizer shipped with q4 matches the one used in local eval harness. Also check Unicode normalization form (NFKC vs NFC).

noor (evals): quick run: with normalize_digits=false the LRMARK isn't inserted but the space still appears in the q4 tokens. So two separate issues: space insertion (minifier fallback) + bidi anchoring (normalize_digits).

tim (quant): Good to know. I'll open a patch: revert minifier fallback for digit-clusters and disable normalize_digits in q4 exports for a hotfix. Longer-term: sync tokenizer test vectors into export CI.

olga (solutions): I'll draft a partner note: short mitigation + ETA for hotfix (tim says ~3-4 hours for hotfix + canary).

ravi (serving): I'll keep extended kv debug in canary for the next 12h to confirm no further index mismatches once hotfix is out.

noor (evals): summary: regression observed in mariner-v2-q4 causing stray spaces and bidi marks around CJK+Hebrew boundaries; two root causes suspected (tokenizer minifier fallback + digit normalization). Rollback in two regions completed. Action: tokenizer binary diff + disable normalize_digits in q4 (tim), focused subtitle eval subset (noor), keep kv debug logging (ravi).
